dialogue.content: （こんばんは。相談員役です。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら開始しますね。）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. I'm the counselor for this session. It's a pleasure to be working with you today. We'll begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: 今晩わ、HARU3では無いですか？先程お話したので、もし同じ人なら内容変えなければと思いお尋ねしています
dialogue.English: Good evening, aren't you HARU3? We spoke a little while ago, so I'm asking because if you're the same person, I thought I should change the topic.

dialogue.content: 3じゃなくてさんです、(困る)
dialogue.English: Not 3, I mean 'san.' (This is awkward)

dialogue.content: （違いますよ。なので、内容は気にしないで大丈夫ですよ。）
dialogue.English: (No, I'm not. So please don't worry about the topic.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: （はい、こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Yes, I look forward to it as well.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。まずはじめに、年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: こんばんわ、56歳女です。先日会社で受けたパワハラ研修についてモヤモヤしているのでお話したいと思って来ました
dialogue.English: Good evening. I’m a 56-year-old woman. I came today because I've been feeling unsettled about a power harassment training session I attended at work the other day and wanted to talk about it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。パワハラ研修ではどのようなことにモヤモヤしたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What about the training left you feeling unsettled?

dialogue.content: 研修が行われた理由は、3人の職員が訴えられたからです。その中の1人が研修を受けた数日後「パワハラしてる人って自覚ないんだろーね」と私に話しかけてきました。続く⬇️
dialogue.English: The training was held because three employees were accused of it. A few days after the training, one of them came up to me and said, "People who commit power harassment probably aren't even aware they're doing it, right?" To be continued...

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 研修受けたけどあの人何も変わってないと、訴えられてはいないけど職場でパワハラしている人の事を私に話してきました。
dialogue.English: She then started talking to me about someone else at work who commits power harassment but hasn't been accused, saying, "That person went to the training, but they haven't changed at all."

dialogue.content: モヤモヤします
dialogue.English: It leaves me feeling unsettled.

dialogue.content: パワハラしてる人多くて話こんがらがると思います....すみません
dialogue.English: There are a lot of people committing power harassment, so I think my story might get confusing... I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。確認させていただきたいのですが、パワハラを訴えられた３人のうちの１人が訴えられてはいないけど、職場でパワハラをしている人に対して、「あの人変わってないよね」とおっしゃった、という意味でよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for explaining. I'd like to confirm: one of the three people who were accused of power harassment said to you, "that person hasn't changed," referring to someone else who also commits harassment at work but hasn't been accused. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: そうです、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 当の本人に反省の色が見えないばかりか他の人の文句を言ってしまうなんて・・・それはモヤモヤしますよね。
dialogue.English: For the very person in question to not only show no signs of remorse but also to complain about someone else... that would certainly be unsettling.

dialogue.content: です
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: ハラスメントをしている人は無自覚ですの冒頭の言葉が蘇りました。と言うかなんと言うか笑
dialogue.English: It brought back the opening words of the training: "People who harass others are unaware they are doing it." I mean, what can you even say... haha.

dialogue.content: 仰ったのは臨床心理士さんです
dialogue.English: It was a clinical psychologist who said that.

dialogue.content: まさにその言葉の通りの出来事が起こったわけですね。
dialogue.English: So what happened was exactly as those words described.

dialogue.content: 目の前で！
dialogue.English: Right in front of my eyes!

dialogue.content: と言うか当事者ですが....
dialogue.English: Or rather, I'm involved...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。そのような冒頭の言葉があったにも関わらず、前述の出来事があったのでは、なおさらモヤモヤされますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. The fact that this happened despite the training starting with those words must make you feel even more unsettled.

dialogue.content: 当事者、ということは、相談者様がパワハラを受けられたということですか？
dialogue.English: When you say you're involved, does that mean you have experienced power harassment yourself?

dialogue.content: でも、自覚がないからハラスメントは起きると思っているので、やっぱりなと思っただけです
dialogue.English: But I believe harassment happens because people are unaware of what they're doing, so I just thought, “Figures.”

dialogue.content: パワハラ受けたとこ何度も有ります
dialogue.English: I’ve experienced power harassment many times.

dialogue.content: 今回訴えられた人が直属の上司だった時や、今回訴えられてないけど分かってないよねと言われてる人など
dialogue.English: From people like the person who was just accused, back when they were my direct supervisor, and from the person who hasn't been accused but about whom people say, "they just don't get it."

dialogue.content: それはとてもお辛い経験をされましたね。そして、当の本人が無自覚となると、怒りの気持ちも湧き出てくると思うのですが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.English: That must have been a very painful experience. And when the person responsible is so unaware, I imagine feelings of anger might also come up. Is that how it is for you?

dialogue.content: またはあきらめの境地でもいいましょうか・・・相談者様としてはどのようにお思いですか？
dialogue.English: Or perhaps it's more of a sense of resignation... What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: 怒りを超えて可哀想な人だと。あなた達のせいで何人辞めたか。会社は見て見ぬふりで常に求人。色んなシステムは出来たけど、私の若い頃となんにも変わってないなと
dialogue.English: It's beyond anger; I just see them as pitiful people. So many people have quit because of them. The company turns a blind eye and is constantly hiring. Various systems have been put in place, but I feel like nothing has changed since I was young.

dialogue.content: 色んなシステム🟰国です
dialogue.English: By “various systems,” I mean national ones.

dialogue.content: 怒りさえも通りこしてしまったのですね。やるせさなを感じますね・・・。もし、差し支えなければ、パワハラについて、どのようなことがあったのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: So you've moved past even anger. It sounds so disheartening... If you don't mind, could you tell me more about what kind of power harassment you experienced?

dialogue.content: やるせさな→やるせなさ　の間違いです
dialogue.English: I misspoke; I meant “a sense of helplessness.”

dialogue.content: 今回処分対処になった人はロジハラです。これはとても照明が難しいらしく.....でも労務士から「前職もロジハラ報告上がっていたのに雇ったのはこちら側の責任ですよね」と。訴えられたけど私に分かってないよねと言ってきた人は精神的なハラスメントですそして私が最近まで受けたハラスメントは完全無視型です
dialogue.English: The person who was disciplined this time commits logical harassment. Apparently, that's very difficult to prove... but the labor consultant said, "There were reports of logical harassment at their previous job, so it's our responsibility for hiring them." The person who was accused but said to me that someone else "doesn't get it" commits psychological harassment. And the harassment I received until recently was the complete silent treatment type.

dialogue.content: 照明❌証明、すみません
dialogue.English: I meant 'proof,' not 'lighting'—sorry for the typo.

dialogue.content: その完全無視型の人を分かってないよねと精神的ハラスメントで訴えられてる人から聞かされました
dialogue.English: The person accused of psychological harassment is the one who told me that the person who gives the silent treatment “doesn’t get it.”

dialogue.content: 分かりづらくてすみません
dialogue.English: Sorry if that’s hard to follow.

dialogue.content: 証明が難しいハラスメントなだけに、職場に与える影響も大きいですね。それだけに大きな課題だと感じました。また、会社の対応が追いついていない点においても、無力感を感じてしまいますね。
dialogue.English: Precisely because it’s a type of harassment that’s difficult to prove, its impact on the workplace is that much more significant. I can see it's a major issue. And the fact that the company's response isn't keeping up must also make you feel powerless.

dialogue.content: ロジハラの例は、私がミスをした時理由の説明に行くと言い訳だと一刀両断され一切の状況報告は無視されました。
dialogue.English: An example of the logical harassment is when I made a mistake and went to explain the reason, I was curtly dismissed with "that's just an excuse," and my entire report on the situation was ignored.

dialogue.content: 今回訴えた職員は録音もしていましたが、ソレだけを聞くとどっちもどっちだと
dialogue.English: The staff member who filed the complaint this time had also made recordings, but if you only listen to those, it sounds like both sides are at fault.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったのですね。それでは、説明にいくこと自体に苦手意識を持ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That must have been difficult. It would make you hesitant to even go and explain things, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: そこに至る過程は無視されていました
dialogue.English: The process leading up to it was ignored.

dialogue.content: 録音内容についての検証についても納得がいかない状況だったのですね。
dialogue.English: So you were also dissatisfied with how the recordings were reviewed.

dialogue.content: 何故録音する様な気持ちになったのか....そこは焦点にならないようです
dialogue.English: Why they felt they had to resort to recording... that doesn't seem to be the focus.

dialogue.content: 労災認定の為提出してきたそうです
dialogue.English: Apparently, they submitted it to get certified for workers' compensation.

dialogue.content: 会社じゃなくて労基に直行すれば良かったのにと.....
dialogue.English: They should have gone straight to the Labor Standards Inspection Office instead of the company...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・。確かにそういった回答となると、労基所へ行けばよかったのに、と
dialogue.English: I see... Yes, with that kind of response, it's natural to think they should have gone to the Labor Standards Inspection Office.

dialogue.content: 思われますよね・・・。職場でもほかにもパワハラで困っている方は多くいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: I can see why you'd feel that way... Are there many other people at your workplace who are struggling with power harassment?

dialogue.content: はい、でも伝えるすべも無いし、伝えて会社が大事になるのもとか....そしてモヤモヤ
dialogue.English: Yes, but there's no way to report it, and we worry that if we do, it will become a big issue for the company... and that leaves us feeling unsettled.

dialogue.content: パワハラで辛い気持ちの人は何人もいます
dialogue.English: There are many people who are hurting because of the power harassment.

dialogue.content: 皆さん辛い気持ちを抱えながら頑張っておられるのですね。
dialogue.English: So everyone is doing their best while holding onto these painful feelings.

dialogue.content: はい、私はそんな仲間たちが大好きです
dialogue.English: Yes, and I love those colleagues who are going through this with me.

dialogue.content: 相談者様も、長年そういった思いを抱えながら、ここまで本当によく頑張ってこられましたよね。
dialogue.English: You, too, have been holding onto these feelings for many years. You've done so well to persevere through it all.

dialogue.content: 一方では、大好きだといえる仲間が近くにいる幸せも・・。
dialogue.English: On the other hand, there's the happiness of having beloved colleagues nearby...

dialogue.content: その大好きな仲間たちとはいろいろな思いを共有うできているんですか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to share your various feelings with those colleagues you love so much?

dialogue.content: 私はなんにも頑張ってません😊ただ、リーダーは嫌事言うのが仕事だったりします。お互いの理解とハラスメントの限度？のバランスが大切なのかなぁと
dialogue.English: I’m not doing anything special 😊 It’s just that a leader's job sometimes involves saying unpleasant things. I think the balance between mutual understanding and the limits of what counts as harassment is what's important.

dialogue.content: 相談者様はそのように考えることができるんですね。素晴らしいと思います。
dialogue.English: It’s wonderful that you’re able to see it that way. I think that's amazing.

dialogue.content: 仲間と共有.....女の職場なのでどこまで共有出来てるかはσ(∵`)？ですが
dialogue.English: Sharing with my colleagues... well, it's an all-female workplace, so I'm not sure how much we're really able to share σ(∵`)?

dialogue.content: 女性の職場なのですね。相談者様がおっしゃられるように、お互いの理解はとても大切ですよね。お互いを認め合ってこそ、良い職場の雰囲気も創られますよね。
dialogue.English: I see, it's an all-female workplace. As you say, mutual understanding is very important. A good workplace atmosphere is created when people can acknowledge and respect one another, isn't it?

dialogue.content: それが1番難しい....です
dialogue.English: That’s the hardest part…

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね。一度に全部やろうとするととても難しいことだと思います。
dialogue.English: It really is, isn't it? I think it becomes very difficult when you try to do everything at once.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 少しずつでも、今からでも何かできそうなこと、考えてみませんか？
dialogue.English: Shall we think about something we could do, even if it's just a small step, starting from now?

dialogue.content: 私に何が出来るでしょう
dialogue.English: What could I possibly do?

dialogue.content: 例えば、挨拶も一つのコミュニケーションだと思います。
dialogue.English: For example, I believe that even a simple greeting is a form of communication.

dialogue.content: そんなの当たり前、という見方もあると思いますが
dialogue.English: Some might say that’s obvious, but

dialogue.content: ご自身を表現することの一つであり、相手に対して関心を持っているよ、というサインでもあります。
dialogue.English: it’s one way of expressing yourself, and it's also a sign that you have an interest in the other person.

dialogue.content: 挨拶しても無視されます！私はそれでも挨拶し続けたら会話できるようになりました。でも挫けてる人がたくさん.....
dialogue.English: They ignore me when I greet them! But I kept at it, and eventually, we were able to have conversations. A lot of people have given up, though...

dialogue.content: 年単位なので挫けます。私はただの鈍感笑
dialogue.English: It takes years, so people get discouraged. I’m just thick-skinned, haha.

dialogue.content: パワハラ研修でモヤモヤされてお越しいただいたわけですが、相談者様はお互いの理解とハラスメントの限度のバランスが大切かなぁ、といった、とても大事な視点をお持ちですよね。なので、そういった相談者様なら、たとえ無視されていると感じても、積み上げることができるのでは？？と思いました。
dialogue.English: You came here today feeling unsettled by the power harassment training, but you have a very important perspective—that a balance between mutual understanding and the limits of harassment is key. That's why I felt that someone with your insight would be able to keep building on that, even if you feel you're being ignored.

dialogue.content: 私はへっちゃらだけど、周りの仲間を見ていると辛いです
dialogue.English: I'm fine, but it's hard to watch what my colleagues are going through.

dialogue.content: 仲間もへっちゃらって言ってくれてます
dialogue.English: My colleagues say they’re fine with it, too.

dialogue.content: 相談者様はお強い方ですね。そしてあたたかいお気持ちを持たれたお母さんのような方ですね。ご自身のことよりも周りの方を常に感じながら時間を過ごされているのですね。
dialogue.English: You're a very strong person. And you have such a warm heart, like a mother. You always seem to be thinking about those around you more than yourself.

dialogue.content: お仲間さんがへっちゃらって言ってくれてるのは、相談者様が明るく対応されているからだと、私は思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I think the reason your colleagues say they're fine is because you handle the situation with such a positive attitude.

dialogue.content: そんな事ないです。自分が大切だから周りも大切にしたいわがままです
dialogue.English: That's not true. It's selfish, really. I value myself, so I want to value those around me, too.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それはとても素晴らしいことですよ。ご自身を大切にできているから、周りの方も大切にできている、ということですね。
dialogue.English: That's a truly wonderful thing. Because you value yourself, you're able to value those around you as well.

dialogue.content: そんな相談者様がいるから、周りの方も明るい気持ちでいられるのだと感じました。
dialogue.English: I feel that because you're there, the people around you are able to stay positive as well.

dialogue.content: そー言って頂くとますます仲間を大切にしたいと思いました
dialogue.English: Hearing you say that makes me want to cherish my colleagues even more.

dialogue.content: パワハラについては、とても大変な思いを抱えられていると思いました。しかし、相談者様や周りのお仲間さんとの仲がとてもよさそうなので、今は少し安心しています。
dialogue.English: I understand you're dealing with very difficult feelings regarding the power harassment. However, it sounds like you have a very good relationship with your colleagues, so I feel a little relieved now.

dialogue.content: パワハラを起こす相手のことを変える、ということはむずかしいけれでも、そういった職場において、相談者様がどのように在りたいのかを思いながら、お仲間たちと共に頑張っていく、ということはできるのかな？とおもいました。
dialogue.English: It's difficult to change the people who commit power harassment, but I was thinking that in that kind of workplace, it might be possible for you to continue doing your best alongside your colleagues, while focusing on how you yourself want to be.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。パワハラ野郎を敵視するだけじゃなくて野郎達にも仲間意識で接する様に心掛けます
dialogue.English: Thank you. I’ll try not to just see the power harassment jerks as enemies, but to approach even them with a sense of camaraderie.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございましたm(_ _)m
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. m(_ _)m

dialogue.content: 相談者様の視野の広さに驚いております。前向きな気持ちに、たくさんのエールを送りたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm amazed at the breadth of your perspective. I want to send you lots of encouragement for your positive attitude.

dialogue.content: 最後までありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for staying with me until the end.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、今日は相談に来ていただきありがとうございました。相談者様の太陽のような明るさにこれからの希望を感じました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for coming to talk with me today. I felt a sense of hope for the future in your sun-like brightness.

dialogue.content: 泣きます
dialogue.English: That makes me want to cry.

dialogue.content: 情の深さを感じます。また何かありましたら、いつでもいらしてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I can feel the depth of your compassion. Please feel free to come back anytime if anything else comes up.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: I will!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。では、今日の相談窓口は終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. With that, I'll be closing today's counseling session.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました！ロールプレイを囚虜うしますね。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you! I’ll end the role-play now.)

dialogue.content: （終了しますね　笑）
dialogue.English: (We’ll wrap up here. Haha.)

dialogue.content: 笑
dialogue.English: (laughs)
